name: BotShield
description: Bot classification, rate limiting, blocking, geo enrichment and reporting via an HTTP middleware.
project_description: BotShield is a request-level bot mitigation module for Drupal 10.3+/11. A single stack middleware (priority 250) classifies each request's User-Agent against configurable regex rules, applies per-bot and per-IP/CIDR policies (allow / rate_limit / block), enforces path-group and site-wide flood-control safety nets via the core Flood API, and temporarily blocks abusive client IPs with a customizable HTTP 429 response. Events are logged to dedicated database tables and enriched with geolocation from CDN headers, a local GeoLite2 MMDB (geoip2/geoip2), or an optional throttled free geo API. Admin report pages provide a dashboard, status/health check, filterable event log, a Leaflet map, and flood-alert history (watchdog/email/Slack). Configuration lives in botshield.settings and is gated by the 'administer botshield' permission; report pages require 'view botshield reports'. Retention cleanup runs on cron. Intended for high-traffic sites that need Drupal-native visibility and control over crawlers and automated traffic without blocking all bots.
